  • T: Anshar made ready to speak,
  • L: anšar ← Anšar I; pâšu ← pû I “(also OB)”; īpušam-ma ← epēšu II “to do”

  • L: ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; kaka ← Kakka I; sukkallīšu ← šukkallu I “(a court official)”; amāta ← awātu I “word”; izakkar ← zakāru I “to speak, say”

3

  • N: kaka | sukkallu || muṭīb | kabattīya
  • T: “Kakka, vizier who contents me,
  • L: kaka ← Kakka I; sukkallu ← šukkallu I “(a court official)”; muṭīb ← ṭiābu I “to be(come) good”; kabattīya ← kabattu I “liver, also innards”

4

  • N: ašriš (|) lahmu (u) lahāmu || kâta | lušpurka
  • T: “Let it be you that I send off toward Lahmu and Lahamu.
  • L: ašriš ← ašriš II “M/jB”; lahmu ← Lahmu I; (u) ← u I “and, but, also”; lahāmu ← Lahamu I; kâta ← kâti I “you (2 sg. pron.) Bab.”; lušpurka ← šapāru I “to send”

5

  • N: šiteʾʾâ | mūdâta || tiṣbura | teleʾʾe
  • T: “You know how [to find a way], you can make a fine speech.
  • L: šiteʾʾâ ← še'û I “also šê'u to seek (out)”; mūdâta ← edû II “to know (M/NA cf. wadûm)”; tiṣbura ← ṣabāru I “to twinkle”; teleʾʾe ← le'û I “to be able, powerful”

6

  • N: ilī | abbīya || šūbika | ana mahrīy[a]
  • T: “Send over to my presence the gods my ancestors,
  • L: ilī ← ilu I “pl. ilū, ilānu god, deity a or the god, also du.”; abbīya ← abu I “father (st. constr. abi, occas. abu, ab”; šūbika ← abāku I “to lead away OA, NA, M/NB”; ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; mahrīy[a] ← mahru II “front”

7

  • N: lībukūnim-ma (||) ilī | nagabšun
  • T: “Let them bring all the gods before me.
  • L: lībukūnim-ma ← abāku I “to lead away OA, NA, M/NB”; ilī ← ilu I “pl. ilū, ilānu god, deity a or the god, also du.”; nagabšun ← nagbu I

8

  • N: lišāna | liškunū || ina qerêti | lišbū
  • T: “Let them converse, sit down at a feast,
  • L: lišāna ← lišānu I “f. tongue, language”; liškunū ← šakānu I “to put, place, lay down”; ina ← ina I “(im-m..., ip-p... etc.) in, on”; qerêti ← qerītu I “pl. also qerrētu?”; lišbū ← ašābu I “to sit (down)”
  • Parallels: L I.2 SB "III" 133

  • N: ašnan | līkulū || liptiqū | kurunna
  • T: “On produce of the field let them feed, imbibe of the vine.
  • L: ašnan ← ašnan I “grain, cereals O/jB as generic term”; līkulū ← akālu I “to eat”; liptiqū ← patāqu II “to drink jB”; kurunna ← kurunu I “(a kind of beer) Bab.(lit.) offered to deity”
  • Parallels: L I.2 SB "III" 134

  • N: ana marduk | mutīr (|) gimillīšunu || lišīmū | šīmta
  • T: “Let them ordain destiny for Marduk, their champion.
  • L: ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; marduk ← Marduk I; mutīr ← târu I “to turn, return”; gimillīšunu ← gimillu I “pl. f. requital, favour friendly deed (for/as reward)”; lišīmū ← šiāmu I “to fix, decree”; šīmta ← šīmtu I “st. constr. šīmti, occas. šimit what is fixed”

  • N: iʾir (|) alik (|) kaka || qudmīšunu | iziz-ma
  • T: “Be off, Kakka, wait upon them,
  • L: iʾir ← âru I “to go (up to) OAkk, Bab., OA”; alik ← alāku I “to go”; kaka ← Kakka I; qudmīšunu ← qudmu I; iziz-ma ← izuzzu I “to stand”

  • N: [mi]mmû | azakkarūka || šunnâ | ana šâšun
  • T: “All that I tell you, repeat to them:
  • L: [mi]mmû ← mimmû I “partly declined”; azakkarūka ← zakāru I “to speak, say”; šunnâ ← šanû III “to do twice, do for a second time”; ana ← ana I “(aš-š... etc.) to, for (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n…”; šâšun ← šâšunu I “(to/of) them”

  • T: ‘It is Anshar your son who has ordered me to come,
  • L: anšar-[(ma)] ← Anšar I; mārūkunu ← māru I “son, descendant”; umaʾʾiranni ← âru I “to go (up to) OAkk, Bab., OA”

  • N: [têre]t | libbīšu || ušaṣbiranni | yâti
  • T: ‘He has bade me speak in full the command of his heart,
  • L: [têre]t ← têrtu I “instruction also pl.”; libbīšu ← libbu I “inner body”; ušaṣbiranni ← ṣabāru I “to twinkle”; yâti ← yâti I “me (1 sg. acc. pron.)”

  • N: [umma | ti]āmtu || ālittani | izerrannâti
  • T: ‘To wit: “Tiamat our mother has grown angry with us,
  • L: [umma ← umma I “saying:, ptcl. introducing dir. speech OAkk(Ur III), Bab., O/MA”; ti]āmtu ← Tiamat I; ālittani ← ālittu I “one who gives/has given/is about to give birth Bab.”; izerrannâti ← zêru I “to dislike, hate”

16

  • N: [puhra | šit]kunat-ma || aggiš | labbat
  • T: “She has assembled a host, savage with rage.
  • L: [puhra ← puhru I “pl. f. assembly”; šit]kunat-ma ← šakānu I “to put, place, lay down”; aggiš ← aggiš I “furiously Bab., NA”; labbat ← labābu I “to rage O/jB”
  • Parallels: L I.2 SB "II" 12; L I.2 SB "III" 74

  • N: ishurūšim-ma (||) ilū | gimiršun
  • T: “All the gods rallied around her,
  • L: ishurūšim-ma ← sahāru I “to go around, turn”; ilū ← ilu I “pl. ilū, ilānu god, deity a or the god, also du.”; gimiršun ← gimru I “totality”
  • Parallels: cf. L I.2 SB "I" 127; L I.2 SB "II" 13; L I.2 SB "III" 75

18

  • N: adi (|) ša (|) attunu | tabnâ || idāša | alkū
  • T: “Even those you created are going over to her side.
  • L: adi ← adi I “until, as far as”; ša ← ša I “who(m), which”; attunu ← attunu I “you (2 m. pl. pron.)”; tabnâ ← banû IV “to create”; idāša ← idu I “pl. m. & f. arm”; alkū ← alāku I “to go”
  • Parallels: L I.2 SB "II" 14; L I.2 SB "III" 76

19

  • N: immasrūnim-ma | iduš (||) tiāmti | tebûni
  • T: “They massed around her, drew up at Tiamat's side.
  • L: immasrūnim-ma ← maṣāru I “Bab.”; iduš ← idu I “pl. m. & f. arm”; tiāmti ← Tiamat I; tebûni ← tebû I “OAkk, Ass. tabā'u(m), NB tabû to get up, arise, set out”
  • Parallels: L I.2 SB "I" 129; L I.2 SB "II" 15; L I.2 SB "III" 77

20

  • N: ezzū | kapdū || lā sākipū | mūša u imma
  • T: “Angry, scheming, never lying down night and day,
  • L: ezzū ← ezēzu I “to be(come) angry, rage Bab.”; kapdū ← kapādu I “to plan, scheme Bab., M/NA”; lā ← lā I “not, no”; sākipū ← sākipu I “resting jB in lā s. unrelenting”; mūša ← mūšu I “night”; u ← u I “and, but, also”; imma ← immu I “heat (of day), daytime O/jB opp. to night”
  • Parallels: L I.2 SB "I" 130; L I.2 SB "II" 16; L I.2 SB "III" 78

21

  • N: našû | tamhāra || nazarbubū | labb[ū]
  • T: “Eager for battle, rumbling, raging,
  • L: našû ← našû II “to lift, carry”; tamhāra ← tamhāru I “battle, combat OAkk, O/jB”; nazarbubū ← nazarbubu I “~ to (tremble with) rage O/jB”; labb[ū] ← labābu I “to rage O/jB”
  • Parallels: L I.2 SB "I" 131; L I.2 SB "II" 17; L I.2 SB "III" 79
NinNA1 o 21. na-šu-u₂ tam-ha-ri na#-zar-bu-bu lab-b[u]

22

  • N: ukkinna | šitkunū-ma || ibannû | ṣūlā[ti]
  • T: “Forming a host, that they might start hostilities.
  • L: ukkinna ← ukkinnu I “assembly (of the gods) jB”; šitkunū-ma ← šakānu I “to put, place, lay down”; ibannû ← banû IV “to create”; ṣūlā[ti] ← ṣūlātu I “pl. tant. battle, combat j/NB(poet.)”
  • Parallels: L I.2 SB "I" 132; L I.2 SB "II" 18; L I.2 SB "III" 80
NinNA1 o 22. ukkin-na šit-ku-nu-ma i#-ban-nu-u₂ ṣu-la-a-[ti]

23
